jobs.title: HR Generalist (Hybrid - Houston, TX area)
jobs.description: Job Summary The HR Generalist reports to the REX Center and is responsible for handling basic HR matters and activities to support assigned business groups (FOCs). The HR Generalist will perform various Dayforce system tasks required including validation of employee data to ensure compliance and system integrity, respond to employee verification requests, standard policy questions and concerns, onboarding, recruiting, and validating standard employee forms. HR Generalist will work closely with the HRBP and the REX Center to resolve and respond to complex HR issues and/or escalate as necessary. As this role handles personal and sensitive employee information, the HR Generalist is expected to use discretion, follow privacy, and information security procedures. Physical Requirements Stand or Sit(Stationary position), Walk(Move, Traverse), Use hand/fingers to handle or feel (Operate, Activate, Use, Prepare, Inspect, Place, Detect, Position), Talk/hear(Communicate, Detect, Converse with, Discern, Convey, Express oneself, Exchange information), See (Detect, Determine, Perceive, Identify, Recognize, Judge, Observe, Inspect, Estimate, Assess), Reaching, Repetitive Motion Function in the Job Sedentary Work- Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met. Job Function • Acts as a Liaison between the REX Center and FOCs • Provides guidance/directs employees appropriately when HR related questions or concerns arise • Gathers employee information and documents in response to requests by the REX Center, HRBP and/or HR Operations Manager • Provide direct support to company employees, other HR groups, and company management as part of the centralized function to handle a variety of HR-related transactions • Processes various transactions such as new hires, terminations, job transfers, job changes, compensation, etc. in Ceridian Dayforce system and support HRBP as needed; communicates with the REX center and ensures follow up and closure to assigned open tickets in ServiceNow • Partners with REX Center and FOCs to communicate basic human resource policies and procedures • Performs necessary research and work to escalate and resolve basic HR related issues and questions • Maintains utmost confidentiality of all requests • Facilitates and/or provides necessary Dayforce training • Identify when HR employee matters require escalation and involvement with HRBP and escalate accordingly • Communicates appropriate responses to HR related issues (employees and FOC management) • Make recommendations to HR Lead, Supervisor and HR Operations Manager continuous improvement SUPPLEMENTAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES • Assist with preparation of responses to requests for records (e.g., subpoenas, Internal/External Audit, etc.) • All other duties and responsibilities assigned by management Required Skills • High School diploma or GED required • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources or related field preferred • Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in an HR related role required • Call center experience preferred • Strong listening skills with a patient and empathetic demeanor • Bilingual speaking English/Spanish preferred • Union experience preferred • Critical thinking, analytical and problem-solving skills essential • Ability to identify when requests or HR related matters require escalation to resolve timely • Experience in a manufacturing or other environment with a large hourly (blue-collar) employee population and multiple locations preferred • Clear and effective verbal and written communication skills • Dedication to customer satisfaction • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products • Must be diligent, strong work ethic with an attention to detail and accuracy • Works with a sense of urgency handling tasks with the ability to multi-task • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and professionalism while maintaining a positive attitude • Ceridian Dayforce experience is a plus • Ability to build positive relationships with all levels and customers within an organization EEO Statement Reliance, Inc. jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.location: PDM Steel Service Centers, Inc. - Fresno, CA
jobs.description: Job Summary This position is part of the Human Resources job family and encompasses professional and administrative responsibilities for managing, administering, advising on, and delivering human resources programs, services, and solutions. In addition to supporting the primary work location, this role is responsible for providing regular on-site Human Resources support to two additional locations within the PDM Group companies. Responsibilities may include employee relations, labor relations, payroll and benefits administration, compliance, staffing, onboarding and offboarding, leave administration, investigations, performance management, HRIS support, and other specialized Human Resources functions. The role also contributes to fostering a workplace culture that supports and empowers employees, delivers exceptional service to internal customers, and positively impacts the communities in which the organization operates. Physical Requirements Stand or Sit(Stationary position), Walk(Move, Traverse), Stoop, kneel, crouch, or Crawl(Position self(to), Move), Talk/hear(Communicate, Detect, Converse with, Discern, Convey, Express oneself, Exchange information), Climb (stairs/ladders) or balance (Ascend/Descend, Work atop, Traverse), See (Detect, Determine, Perceive, Identify, Recognize, Judge, Observe, Inspect, Estimate, Assess), Pushing or Pulling, Reaching, Repetitive Motion Function in the Job Sedentary Work- Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met. Job Function Process Weekly Payroll and Monthly Incentive Pay. Maintains historical human resource records by designing a filing and retrieval system. Maintains HRIS data and runs required reports. Support staffing needs by participating in the job posting recruiting and interviewing process. Maintain confidentiality in all dealings with management and employees. Ensures compliance with USCIS Form I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification; periodically audits Forms I-9. Assist with sit Safety Program and DOT compliance. Participate in Employee Engagement activities program. Conduct onboarding and offboarding of employees for location. Assist and participate in employee investigations. Assist in the generation and tracking of employee Disciplinary Notices. Assist with preparing and tracking Annual Performance Reviews. Assist with Leave of Absence case administration. Represents organization at Unemployment Hearings. Participates in Internal and External Audits of HR and PR compliance. Maintain the work structure by updating job requirements and job descriptions for all positions. Ensure legal compliance by monitoring and implementing applicable human resource federal and state Maintains guidelines by preparing, updating, and recommending human resource policies and procedures. Cooperate with Reliance reporting standards regarding compliance and other information requests. Provide regular on-site Human Resources support to two additional locations within the PDM Group companies, partnering with local management and employees to ensure consistent HR service delivery, policy administration, employee relations support, and compliance. Other duties as assigned by management. Required Skills · 5-7 plus years of relevant Human Resources Management experience required. · High School diploma/GED required, Bachelor degree preferred. · Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively required. · Ability to exercise discretion when handling sensitive/confidential employment information required. · Understanding of broad concepts and principles pertinent to Human Resources Management operations required. · Excellent oral and written communication skills required. · Ability to make sound decisions based on a combination of factors including analysis, knowledge and experience, and judgment required. · Ability to initiate and maintain cooperative relationships with co-workers as well as internal/external customers required. · Prior Human Resources experience supporting employees and management in a unionized environment, including working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements, grievance processes, and labor relations practices, required. · Strong computer proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), as well as general HR software platforms and internet-based search engines required. Compensation Range The anticipated compensation for this position is USD $85,000.00/Yr. - USD $98,000.00/Yr. depending on experience, qualifications, and location. EEO Statement Reliance, Inc. IS A DRUG-FREE WORK ENVIRONMENT EEO/DISABILITY/VETERAN
